verdict.rationale: Documentation and community evidence confirm skills auto-trigger from context via SessionStart/bootstrap injection across multiple harnesses (Claude Code, Devin, Hermes, Antigravity), with explicit instructions to invoke relevant skills before any action, and users confirm 'skills trigger automatically, you don't need to do anything special' (superpowers-gh-11, superpowers-docs-16, superpowers-docs-7/8, superpowers-gh-8). Community feedback also shows mixed real-world results (increased mistakes for some users), tempering full confidence. Missing for 10: independent hands-on verification that description-engineering reliably selects the *correct* skill in ambiguous multi-skill scenarios, and quantitative data on trigger accuracy/false positives.
